answer: Shards are assigned from the dune graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The fable assignment is published and harbor records each panel. The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so someone cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 416 impostors cost 656 times the honest price and take 30 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
